title: Beta.11 replacement near-miss controls for the redact-secret#948 relabel (948)
description: Synthetic near-miss controls that replace the 25 provider-named near-miss controls docs/decisions/2026-09-29-relabel-provider-named-near-miss-controls-under-948.md relabelled to policy/T3 on generic-token, so datadog-api-key, mailgun-api-key, postman-api-key, sentry-org-auth-token, sentry-user-auth-token and travisci-api-token keep their #206 cells. Each keeps its family's near-miss value shape in prose or a log line, never under a credential-named assignment. Values are synthetic, never provider-issued; no observation record is implied.

fixtures.text: The agent rejected a truncated Datadog value (4589a4171b628b5b7ff4), 20 of the 32 hex characters, during setup.
Mailgun rejected the pasted value key-ki44hd1u8ymgb724 because the body is 16 characters, not 32.
2026-09-29T10:00:00Z WARN mailer: dropped a malformed value key-hr5cadzc35task266h95 (20-character body) from the import

2026-09-29T10:00:00Z WARN sentry-cli: sntrys_ee87772cdfa76524e5f8dfacfed77ac052a8f4db3cb6b60c2c098b7962c5057a mixes the organization prefix with a personal hex body; ignored

notes: Generated by fixtures/generated/build.mjs from public deterministic SHA-256 seeds; all credential-shaped values are synthetic and never provider-issued. Ground truth comes from construction, not scanner output. No live verification. Legacy review status: draft — independent human review required.
